note: The six islanders' voices (Hawkes Gen audio.voice-design / audio.voice-save) and their re-acted lines. Voice ids are Gen voice-library ids (gv_...). Keys are the clip names in index.json (same key, .webm replaces .mp3).

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Hi, I'm Pip! The Overseer just beamed you onto the best island on the whole planet. Want the tour? It's mostly things that go fast and things that go boom.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: The rod is at the very end of the pier!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: BOOM! Goodbye, Barrel! Now ask the Overseer for anything.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Told you she likes you. Take the helicopter. Way up!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Huh. That's new.

direction.pace: slow, soft, a long beat after Huh

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: What a day for it!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Hey, you're back!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: The 4x4 is right there: walk up and press E.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: A fish! Take the rocket launcher. Barrels, up the beach. Go on!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Hi! I'm Pip. Welcome to the island!

lines.speaker: bobbin
lines.text: Carry on. That is an order. It is also a suggestion.

direction.emotion: pompous, then a flicker of kindness on the second sentence

lines.speaker: bobbin
lines.text: Salute optional. Appreciated, though.

lines.speaker: bobbin
lines.text: Fine cast. Eight out of ten. The two is for the wind, which I take personally.

direction.emotion: grandly approving, then wounded about the wind

lines.speaker: bobbin
lines.text: That is a rod. Then you are one of mine. Cast from the very end.

lines.speaker: bobbin
lines.text: A wave just looked at me. I took it personally.

lines.speaker: bobbin
lines.text: Ships commanded: one. Ships commanded, again: one.

direction.emotion: reciting from the log, solemn, faintly sad

lines.speaker: bobbin
lines.text: You took the boat out. Then it is a fleet of two. I shall update the logbook. Same boat, longer name.

lines.speaker: bobbin
lines.text: A gull. Do not look at me like that. A gull.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Dear, you've gone a funny colour. Eat something.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Rain at four. Sorry.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: A letter came for the new one, dear. It says: mind the third plank, it sticks. That is all. Sorry.

direction.emotion: warm, secretive, apologising for the secret

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Dear, I brought you a letter. It says: well done. It has no sender. Sorry.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: You caught a fish, dear. The pier told me. You should eat something. Sorry.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: That was a loud one, dear. The chimney held. I did say there might be weather. Sorry.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: Every letter reaches someone. Even the ones nobody sent. I just have not found whose yet.

lines.speaker: ember
lines.text: I did not read it twice. Sorry.

lines.speaker: rolo
lines.text: huh. that's fine. that's mostly fine.

lines.speaker: rolo
lines.text: huh. hi. the 4x4 is fine. mostly fine. flip it and i fix it.

lines.speaker: rolo
lines.text: estimate: three wobbles. maybe a small tuesday.

lines.speaker: rolo
lines.text: huh. it is built. i cannot say why. it is fine. mostly fine.

lines.speaker: rolo
lines.text: there is one thing i cannot fix. it is fine.

lines.speaker: rolo
lines.text: huh. that is the last can. it holds. probably it holds.

lines.speaker: rolo
lines.text: i'm fine. just under here.

lines.speaker: rolo
lines.text: huh. it flew. that is fine. that is mostly fine.

lines.speaker: dolores
lines.text: I was not waiting. The pad is free. Use it. I will not watch.

lines.speaker: dolores
lines.text: I'm not lonely. The hill is just quiet. Stay.

direction.emotion: flat, then a soft crack on Stay
direction.pace: slow, the last word almost a whisper

lines.speaker: dolores
lines.text: Oh. You again. I kept your spot. It was already there. Sit.

lines.speaker: dolores
lines.text: You went up in the helicopter. I did not watch. You turned left at the top. Do not look at me like that.

lines.speaker: dolores
lines.text: You caught a fish. A decent size. I do not care. It had a green back.

direction.emotion: unimpressed, then slips and remembers detail

lines.speaker: dolores
lines.text: The wind is from the east. Not that I checked.

lines.speaker: dolores
lines.text: Scratched into the rock, in fives: the rings, turning. The marks go back further than I have been here.

lines.speaker: dolores
lines.text: I do not care who comes up here. You had a long walk, though.

lines.speaker: channel
lines.text: Breaking: a fish. A real one. More on this as it happens. Nothing happens. Still a record.

direction.pace: fast, a beat before Nothing happens

lines.speaker: channel
lines.text: Breaking: a vehicle, in motion. Driver: you. Ratings: record.
